serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Hi Anon!
Lady Annalie: Are you looking for something specific today?
You: Hmmm…
You: Nothing specific I guess. I’m just looking around for now.
Lady Annalie: Are you perhaps an impulse buyer?
You: Impulse buyer? What’s that?
Lady Annalie: Hmmm…{{wi}} It’s basically a consumer who buys something on impulse. It’s like you would come here not planning to buy anything, but you would buy something anyway.
You: Oh, I think I get it.
You: Well,I just buy whatever would look nice on my bo- I mean girlfriend.
Lady Annalie: That’s an easy way to go on a buying spree and run out of money really quick. Better be careful!
You: Thanks for the advice, but why are you telling me this? Isn’t it better for you if I spent all my money here?
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: Huh?! Well, uh…
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: At first, maybe, but in the long run you not starving on the street would bring me more money. Having a regular client like you would pay off sooner or later. At least I think so.
Lady Annalie: And besides, who do you think I am, huh? Some soulless vampire that would just drink you dry?!
You: Isn’t this your industry’s norm these days?
Lady Annalie: Huh?! Have some faith in society, would you? There are still some good and honest salesmen around here. There is one in front of you right now!
You: Yeah, you are not that bad and prices are really good, but there is still room for improvement.
Lady Annalie: Improvement?! What do you mean?!
You: For example. You are a little perverted. 
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
You: A lot actually.
Lady Annalie: Me?!
